# thunder_debug_rate_limit (Resource)

`thunder_debug_rate_limit`: Debug Rate Limiting

__PLACEHOLDER__

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "thunder" {
  address  = var.dut9049
  username = var.username
  password = var.password
}
resource "thunder_debug_rate_limit" "thunder_debug_rate_limit" {
  dumy = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cpu_id` (Number) Starting From 0
- `dumy` (Number) Dummy
- `entry_ip` (String) Source Address
- `life_cycle_log` (Number) Print entry life cycle info
- `metric` (Number) CPS 0 Uplink 1 Downlink 2 Total 3
- `per_pkt_log` (Number) Print entry info based on code path of each pkt
- `raw_log` (Number) Print entry info per second
- `tpl_id` (Number) Template ID
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
